versions.name: Network readiness check (HTTP / TCP / UDP)
versions.description: Poll a service until it is ready — HTTP status polling (curl), TCP port probe (nc -z), or best-effort UDP probe. Absorbs the old buz/http-check and buz/wait-for-tunnel use cases. Requires curl and nc (openbsd-netcat) on the Runner.
versions.description_zh: 轮询服务直至就绪——HTTP 状态码轮询（curl）、TCP 端口探测（nc -z）、尽力而为的 UDP 探测。整合原 buz/http-check 与 buz/wait-for-tunnel 的场景。需要 Runner 装有 curl 和 nc（openbsd-netcat）。
versions.author: buz maintainers
